# Solent Marine Outboards UK

> UK's premier outboard motors dealership and marine rigging specialists supplying Yamaha, Suzuki, Honda, Mercury, Tohatsu, and Torqeedo engines with certified Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) and nationwide delivery.

## Overview
- **Brand:** Solent Marine Outboards UK
- **Headquarters:** Cowes Yacht Haven, High Street, Cowes, Isle of Wight, PO31 7BD, United Kingdom
- **Contact:** sales@outboardmotors.co.uk | +44 1983 294400 | WhatsApp: +44 7700 900888
- **Minimum Order:** £50.00
- **Free UK Delivery:** On all orders over £500.00 (Includes pallet tail-lift for outboard motors)
- **Warranty:** Full official UK manufacturer warranty (up to 5-6 years)
- **Payment Methods:** UK Bank Transfer (BACS/Faster Payments), Visa, Mastercard, Marine Proforma Invoice, Marine Hire Purchase Finance (12-60 months)

## Product Categories
- [Portable Outboards (2.5HP - 6HP)](https://outboardmotors.co.uk/shop/?category=portable): Ultra-lightweight auxiliary and tender engines starting at £849.
- [Mid-Range EFI Outboards (9.9HP - 30HP)](https://outboardmotors.co.uk/shop/?category=mid-range): Twin-cylinder electronic fuel injected motors for RIBs and dayboats from £2,795.
- [High Horsepower Marine Engines (40HP - 300HP)](https://outboardmotors.co.uk/shop/?category=high-horsepower): High-performance 16-valve multi-cylinder marine engines from £9,945.
- [Electric Outboards & E-Propulsion](https://outboardmotors.co.uk/shop/?category=electric): Ultra-quiet lithium direct-drive clean power from Torqeedo and ePropulsion from £1,949.
- [Commercial 2-Stroke Fleet Engines](https://outboardmotors.co.uk/shop/?category=two-stroke): High-torque workboat motors restricted for professional fishing & rescue fleets under UK RCD II.
- [Marine Oils, Rigging & Genuine Spares](https://outboardmotors.co.uk/shop/?category=parts): Official Yamlube 10W-30 oils, fuel tanks, and service kits from £49.
